operative_changes: Remove disabled legacy dense-auto/adapter calls from Worker.
Use the public base full-vocabulary logits/model/sampler/runner path; remove compact sampling and sparse-presence extensions.
Non-speculative profile_run calls base dummy sampler and frozen prompt-logprob warmup.

Retain public gpu/warmup.py: omit three frozen unseeded compact-sampling warmup requests (greedy, full-distribution, top-k). This changes startup execution; it is not a no-op or complete warmup equivalence claim.
import_changes: CUDA graph warmup uses vllm_mach.mxfp6.warmup rather than private vllm quantization utility.
requirements: Fresh v2 worker; TP1 dense Qwen3.5-4B MXFP8; no speculative decoding/LoRA/prefix/replay/offload/connector.
Compact hybrid flags and vocab-parallel greedy disabled; full-vocabulary head installed after compile.
formalization.gpu_validation: Paired clean startup/capture, fixed-seed full sixpoint and prefill/decode/slot-reuse checks required before release; CPU source checks do not certify output equivalence.

vllm/v1/worker/gpu/input_batch.py:_post_.specialization: Frozen hybrid flags all false -> output_unique_token_ids_ptr=None; remove that unreachable branch and its four unused pointer/stride arguments; all remaining integer operations and launch grid/num_warps match public base.

behavior_proofs.explicit_seed_gate: Executed frozen SamplingStates.add_request/any_explicit_seed and Sampler.get_vocab_parallel_sampling_params on CPU for c4/16/24/32/48/64 with the actual protocol seeds/default filters: all return None and take the normal full-vocabulary path.
behavior_proofs.prompt_logprobs: Public and frozen prompt_logprob.py are byte-identical. Serving normal compute entrypoint is public base; frozen extra profiling launch retained.
behavior_proofs.integer_state: Frozen PenaltiesState assigns both unique-token buffers=None when hybrid flags are false. Frozen _post_update_kernel specializes to public base exact AST after unused arguments/branch removal; launch grid and num_warps=1 unchanged.
behavior_proofs.legacy_adapter_calls: Frozen configure_dense_defaults requires hidden5120/layers64/TP2/FP6. Dense4B TP1 MXFP8 cannot enable defaults; requested producer/prefill flags are false and projection tuning default0, so prepare_model returns before adapter import.
behavior_proofs.quality_logprobs_gate: Quality requests use logprobs=1. Frozen Sampler.get_vocab_parallel_sampling_params returns None whenever max_num_logprobs != NO_LOGPROBS, so these requests use the normal full-vocabulary logits/sampler path. All nine M32 teacher call records match the accepted request geometry/order; this does not establish numerical output equivalence.

startup_warmup.status: Source-comparison evidence only; not an additional installer hash gate.
startup_warmup.operative_delta: Frozen warmup_kernels appends three real request/sample/cleanup cycles gated by model get_top_tokens/sample_full_tokens/sample_topk_tokens methods. Public warmup lacks the entire appended block, and public Qwen model lacks these methods.
startup_warmup.actual_frozen_paths: Accepted startup log records greedy, full-distribution and compact top-k fast paths even with hybrid flags and VLLM_VOCAB_PARALLEL_GREEDY disabled. These unseeded warmup requests ask for no logprobs.
startup_warmup.validation_required: Acceptance of this startup change depends on paired precision, deferred-state/reset/slot-reuse, clean-restart and production performance verification; no numerical or performance neutrality is assumed.
